svg.title: cti-agent delivery pipeline: laptop to production
svg.desc: An update is two commands: task ship on the Mac, then sudo cti-agent-update --for-real on the Fedora server. A MacBook Pro runs task ship, a gated sequence ending in git push to the public GitHub repo zany2dmax/cti-agent. On a Fedora server in Azure, sudo cti-agent-update --for-real pulls the kit from that repo and then runs fleet-kit/install-fedora.sh from it; the installer pulls the Go source itself and is idempotent. GitHub Actions polls the public repo for new tags and copies each new release to the private company repo company-org/cti-agent, which is protected by PrimeSec AI code scan and the task ship gates.
svg.text: Refuses unless all of it passes.
